rejected_patterns.reason: inventory management needs dense comparison, filters, row status, imports, and bulk operational actions
selected item inspection is secondary to scanning and managing the full inventory list

decision_factors.scan_behavior: row scanning by item, SKU, category, price, vendor, status, source, and updated timestamp
decision_factors.primary_user_task: manage inventory records across automated and manual sources

reasons: inventory records share consistent comparable fields
operators need filtering, import, creation, status review, and pagination

responsive_transformation.desktop: sidebar shell with search header, filter toolbar, full inventory table, and pagination
responsive_transformation.tablet: reduced table columns with row overflow actions and persistent filters
responsive_transformation.mobile: stacked inventory record cards with search, filters, status, source, and primary actions preserved
